text:
The photo shows a white bench or fixture plate, roughly square, standing on a grey tiled floor that fills the upper half of the frame. The plate's top surface has molded features: two long parallel recessed channels at the left, two oval recessed pockets along the back edge, several small square raised pads with central holes (two near the middle-rear, one at right, one in the lower centre), and numerous small drilled holes scattered across the surface, including a row along the lower right edge.

Lying on its side in the centre of the plate is a small dark teal/green cylindrical object with a white tapered tip pointing left, resembling a capped syringe or dispensing tube. No liquid is visible.
